description: This file implements a daemon manager and worker processes for PySpark, handling socket communication, process forking, and worker lifecycle management.

methods.name: compute_real_exit_code
methods.description: Converts exit code to integer, defaulting to 1 if not an integer.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Handles communication with a worker process after fork, including authentication, executing worker main, and cleanup.

methods.name: manager
methods.description: Sets up socket server, manages worker processes, handles signals, and coordinates worker lifecycle.
